children.value: citrakṛta ākāraḥ pratimeva vismayena mantharo jaḍīkṛtaḥ
kenacitsiddhena tapasā svīyatapobalena cakreṇa cakravātena hṛta iva

yata idaṃ jagadavidyaivetyartho hṛdi nāyāti ata idaṃ jagadavidyākhyayā brahmaśaktyā
kṛtamutpāditaṃ satyameveti cintayansan

idaṃ dṛśyaṃ kiyadantaṃ kiyaddūrāvadhikaṃ syādetattapolabdhaśarīrakaḥ sannāditaḥ
pṛthivīmārabhya dūratayā ūrdhvapramāṇena dehena gatvā paśyāmi drakṣyāmi

bhāvābhāvātmano'sya dṛśyasyānte asaṃsārapradeśe nityaṃ sukhaṃ sthīyate sthāsyate
mayā

tādṛśamativistīrṇaṃ sadṛṣṭāntopapattikamapi munyuktamabhyāsena vinā bhasmani
hutamiva vṛthā gatamityarthaḥ
mama nirupaplave ātmani viśrāntiḥ kadā syāditi papraccha

sāṃprataṃ dagdhumucitaṃ dāhyaṃ dagdhuṃ śakyamapi dṛśyānarthamākramya na
saṃsthitam

saṃstuto jñātuṃ prastutaḥ tayā vidvatprasiddhayā jñānasāratayā anavabuddhaścātmā
yena tathāvidho'ta eva dolāyamānasaṃvittvam

varadasya tasya vidheḥ sannidhau uddāmadaurātmyānnijaṃ manorathakalpitaṃ varaṃ
mārgayiṣyasi

he deva vidhe asmin dṛśyarūpe
dṛṣṭe avidyābhrame sati ādarśavatsthite brahmaṇi pratibimbamalenojjhitaḥ pradeśo
nāsti yatra gatasya me nirvikṣepasthitiḥ syādityarthaḥ

yataḥ
paramāṇvākṛterapyantaḥsthitasyāsya cidvyomadarpaṇasya yatra tatra idaṃ jagadrūpaṃ
pratibimbati

he vidhe yasmātsāvidyaciteriyaṃ sthitistasmādidamavidyāprayuktaṃ dṛśyaṃ
kiyaddūramidamanarthakṛddṛśyaṃ syāt

tasya dṛśyasya pāre anantaṃ niravidyaṃ
brahma kiyaddūraṃ vā syādākāśavat saṃsāraśūnyaṃ brahma tanmayā
dṛśyamavaśyaṃ gatvā draṣṭavyameva

evaṃrūpamarthaṃ jñātuṃ pratyakṣamanubhavitumimaṃ vakṣyamāṇaṃ varaṃ
saṃprārthaye

iyaṃ me tanuḥ svacchandamṛtyurnīrogā gāruḍena garuḍavegasadṛśena vegena
saṃyutā vyomagāminī cāstu

tu punaḥ pratināḍīkaṃ pratikṣaṇaṃ pratyavayavaṃ ca yojanameṣā me tanurvṛddhiṃ
gacchatu

sa bhavānvyomni tasminvaraprāptyuttarakṣaṇa eva tato
madāśramātplutimūrdhvamuḍḍayanameṣyati

vahangacchansan saritāmanta iva jagatastrailokyasyānte te vapurvardhiṣyate iti
pareṇānvayaḥ

yathā saudhasthastrījanānāṃ vicitravātāyanajālena bahiṣṭhanṛtyasabhāsatyekṣaṇaṃ
rocate nānyadyeṣāṃ tathāvidhānāṃ vicitraṃ vātāyanajālaṃ sadapyasatprāyaṃ tathā
cidākāśasaṃvidāṃ tattvavidāṃ jagadātmakaṃ vaicitryaṃ tatra
sadapyasatprāyamevetyarthaḥ

sarvairurvīsthairjanairindumaṇḍalasaṃlagnatayā dṛṣṭānāṃ dhūmanīhāradhūlyādīnāṃ
jālamindumaṇḍalasthajanadṛśā yādṛgatyantāsat jagadapi ātmanaḥ ananyatvaṃ
prāpya sthite tattvavidi tādṛk atyantāsadevetyarthaḥ
prāṇaṃ recayati śarīrādbahirnayati tacchīlāṃ dhāraṇāṃ kṛtvā

yathā khagaḥ pakṣī
saṃbhuktātphalāddāḍimādeḥ śuṣkaṃ nīrasaṃ bījatvagādibhāgaṃ tyajati tadvat a

śuṣkā nīraktā prāgvarṇitā samātṛmaṇḍalā bhagavatī kālī taddehaṃ
prāgvarṇitaprakāreṇa gaṇaiḥ saha bhakṣayiṣyati

idaṃ bhāvisvadṛḍhasaṃkalpaphalaṃ śrutvā tato nirviṇṇo vyādhastatparihāropāyo'sti
vā na veti pṛcchati - aho ityādinā

yadyasmāddhetoḥ arthena puruṣārthabhrameṇa
duḥkhamevārthitaṃ saṃkalpena samarthitam
he vara śreṣṭha bhagavan saiṣā bhāvyarthasthitistvayoktā

ayaṃ bhavitavyo'rtho yayā
yuktyānyathā syāttathāvidhā kācidyuktirvidyate yadi vā nāsti tattvayā ucyatām
yatastat idāniṃtanayatnato na kṣarati na naśyati

yathā puṃsaḥ svadehe'pi vāmāvāmabhāgayoḥ śiraḥpādayorvā viparyayavidhau
vyatyāsakaraṇe śaktirna vidyate tathā bhāvyarthānāmapyanyathāsthitau sthāpane

tasya parijñānamātraṃ tu śāstrīyopāyairbhavati nānyathātvamityāha -
jyotiḥśāstreti

yaiḥ puruṣadhaureyaiḥ prākṛtaiḥ sukṛtairadyatanāni
śamadamādisādhanānyupetya saṃvinnayairbrahmasaṃvitprāpakaiḥ
śravaṇādyupāyaistattvajñānaṃ prāpya brahmatayaiva suptaṃ na jagaddarśanena
jāgaritaṃ te puruṣaśreṣṭhāḥ prāktanāni sarvakarmāṇi duḥsaṃkalpavedanāni
cātyantadṛḍhatarāṇyapi mūlocchedena jayanti nānye ityarthaḥ
